Class TailPlan<A extends Action>

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sabre.TailPlan<A>
Type Parameters:
A - the type of action this plan is made of
All Implemented Interfaces:
Plan<A>, Countable, Iterable<A>
public class TailPlan<A extends Action> extends Object implements Plan<A>
A plan which is built by appending actions on to the end.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware
